title: Gelyn configuration
description: Settings gelyn reads from appsettings.json. Only the Site section is owned by gelyn; other sections, such as Logging, are left to the host.

Site.title: Site
Site.description: Locations and metadata the generator works with.

Title.description: The name shown in the header and the footer, and used as the document title when a page declares no title of its own in its front matter.

ContentDirectory.description: The directory holding the Markdown sources. Relative values are resolved against the working directory.

OutputDirectory.description: The directory the generated site is written to. Relative values are resolved against the working directory. Existing files are overwritten.
